## Jiongeze Learning Journey

This page provides an overview of the complete Jiongeze pathway.

The journey moves from understanding, to learning, to action, and eventually to contribution and growth.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR

A[Foundation] --> B[Learning]
B --> C[Journey]
C --> D[Community Projects]
D --> E[Reference Resources]
E --> F[Appendices]
F --> G[Growth]
```

## Learning Philosophy

Jiongeze is designed around a simple idea:

**Learn → Practice → Create → Contribute → Grow**

Small steps practiced consistently can become meaningful change.
